The schedule below is a guide to what we will be covering throughout the semester and is subject to change to meet the learning goals of the class. Check this website regularly for the latest schedule and for course materials that will be posted here through links on the schedule.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Key to Books Used Below

- ISL = [**An Introduction to Statistical Learning with Python**](https://www.statlearning.com/), by James, Witten, Hastie, Tibshirani, and Taylor
- UDL = [**Understanding Deep Learning**](https://udlbook.github.io/udlbook/) by Simon Prince
- PRML = [**Pattern Recognition and Machine Learning**](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/publication/pattern-recognition-machine-learning/), by Bishop
- DL = [**Deep Learning**](https://www.deeplearningbook.org/), by Goodfellow, Bengio, and Courville
- RL = [**Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction**](http://incompleteideas.net/book/the-book-2nd.html), by Sutton and Barto
:::
